GeneDef.label: deferred nerves
GeneDef.description: A second nervous system that receives every wound exactly as the first does - the depth, the bleeding, the shock - and then does not pass any of it upward. The body carries on because nobody has told it otherwise.\n\nNothing is prevented: when the nerves finally report they report all of it in one instant, so a body that would have gone down slowly enough to be dragged somewhere safe finds out everything at once.
